# CANDIDATE: NAMED_LEVEL_RSI_DIVERGENCE_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

At key horizontal levels, momentum often weakens before price reverses; RSI divergence provides an early reversal signal. The edge exists because price action can make new extremes while underlying momentum (RSI) fails to confirm, indicating exhaustion and impending reversal.

## Mechanism

Define named level as prior day’s high or low (or weekly pivot). Calculate ATR(14) on 5‑min bars. When price is within 0.1*ATR of the level and makes a new high (for resistance) or low (for support) on a 5‑min bar while RSI(14) fails to make a new high/low (bearish divergence at resistance, bullish divergence at support), enter short at resistance, long at support. Exit: chart‑stop at the named level (invalidates level); TP1 at 1.5R; optional premium‑stop at 1*ATR. Regime filters: only trade when ADX(14) < 20 and VIX between 15‑25; avoid entries when ADX > 25.
